# BAAI regression fixture

Captured from https://hub.baai.ac.cn/papers and
https://hub.baai.ac.cn/papers?model=hotness&time=week on 2026-11-07 UTC.
Four card subtrees are excerpts with only trailing line whitespace stripped (tooltip duplicate titles,
author spans, tags, dates, hotness, and abstracts retained). The inline script
contains one unchanged literal record excerpt from the daily Nuxt payload to
verify exact 15057 rather than rounded display 1.51w. It is never evaluated.

This is a later same-day capture, not the missing 07:01 UTC workflow input.
The old parser reproduces all 18 titles/authors/dates/hotness values printed
in the November 7 report on the full captured daily and weekly pages.
Cases: two authors; one author; AK's Picks/tag pollution; truncated author
list and abbreviated hotness. Ellipsis is not an author; the fixture contains
only authors actually provided by BAAI, not a reconstructed full bibliography.
